bayesian_neural_hybrid.summary: A perceptron that keeps dropout switched on when it predicts, so many stochastic passes give both the prediction (their mean) and how unsure the model is (their spread).
bayesian_neural_hybrid.implementationNote: Monte Carlo dropout (Gal and Ghahramani, 2016), an approximation to a Bayesian neural network rather than variational inference: an ordinary multilayer perceptron trained with dropout, whose dropout stays on at prediction; sample_count sampled networks score every bar, their mean is P(up) (or the price target) and their standard deviation is the epistemic uncertainty, kept on the adapter (last_uncertainty) and averaged over the validation rows in the fit summary. The Gaussian prior on the weights is expressed as weight decay.

hidden_size.label: Hidden size
hidden_size.description: Units in every hidden layer of the perceptron.

layer_count.label: Layer count
layer_count.description: How many hidden layers (each followed by the activation and Monte Carlo dropout) sit between the features and the head.

dropout.label: Dropout
dropout.description: Share of hidden units switched off at random on every pass, in training and at prediction alike; it defines the approximate posterior the sampled networks are drawn from.

sample_count.label: Sample count
sample_count.description: Stochastic forward passes per prediction: their mean is the prediction and their standard deviation the epistemic uncertainty.

learning_rate.label: Learning rate
learning_rate.description: Peak step size of the one-cycle schedule.

weight_decay.label: Weight decay (Gaussian prior)
weight_decay.description: The Gaussian prior on the weights, applied as decoupled weight decay: larger pulls the weights harder toward zero.

batch_size.label: Batch size
batch_size.description: Training rows per optimisation step; batches are contiguous blocks of time.

epochs.label: Epochs
epochs.description: Passes over the training rows, at most; early stopping may end the fit sooner.

patience.label: Early stopping patience
patience.description: Epochs without a better validation loss before the fit stops and the best weights are restored.
